# Frontend mock fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Generated by `npm run contract:fixtures` from the Phase 1 mock services (`src/services/mock`).
Every payload is synthetic (`meta.data_mode: "synthetic"`, `SourceRef.dataset_id: "synthetic"`).
They are **not observations**. They exist only so `tests/test_frontend_fixtures.py` can validate
the frontend's mock responses against the backend Pydantic contracts (API_CONTRACTS §8 rule 7).
